gen-gf-gugi-gf-winky-sans: Winky Sans keeps its capitals barely taller than its lowercase, which gives the text a low, modern hush. Gugi sits above it as a bold display face, each glyph drawn with the simplicity of a single pen tip.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-yantramanav: Yantramanav packs its tall lowercase tightly, with rounded letters that leave generous gaps at the terminals. Gugi, meanwhile, is the showy one, its strokes as plain as stitched thread, while the body simply does the quiet work.
gen-gf-gugi-outfit: Distinctive is the first word that comes to mind for Gugi, whose tall lowercase nearly climbs to the capitals. Outfit then drops to a moderate height, its curves bent like cable and finishing before they close.
gen-gf-gugi-plus-jakarta-sans: Gugi announces itself with tall lowercase and open-cut terminals, curves matching its stems exactly, a loud display voice. Plus Jakarta Sans is the precise sans underneath, its monoline strokes keeping curve endings apart.
gen-gf-gugi-sora: Sora reads precisely, with curves that turn corners without any swell and a c and s kept widely parted. And its moderate lowercase height keeps a long run of text moving smoothly beneath Gugi's tall, bold display letters.
gen-gf-gugi-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk is geometric and neutral. Gugi does the loud, tall-lowercase display work with its open-cut terminals, while the sans takes over for text, its counters breathing and each glyph a ribbon of constant width.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-clash-grotesk: Clash Grotesk is smooth and approachable, with no thick-and-thin modulation. Happy Monkey does the bold, distinctive display work with ruler-straight lines and wide gaps in the e, while the body simply gets on with the reading.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk is lively, with tall lowercase and bowls left unfinished on one side, so it feels quick on its feet. But the strongest thing here is Happy Monkey's ruler-straight, monoline heading set against that taller body.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-hind: Hind keeps its lowercase nearly matching the capitals, with strokes as steady as drawn string and c endings that never turn inward. And Happy Monkey brings a bold, ruler-straight display line above, so a longer passage feels easy to follow.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Wide gaps in the e and a ruler-straight line mark Happy Monkey as bold and distinctive. Pilcrow Rounded adds warmth below, with big counters in tall lowercase, and that moderate-versus-tall height difference is the pair's real strength.
